title: M2 P2P networking red-team adversarial test report
principle: Each case drives a malicious or broken peer against an honest node over REAL libp2p hosts + GossipSub (the same stack as p2p_test.go). Every case asserts the honest node REJECTS the attack while staying alive, un-corrupted, and non-diverged, then proves liveness by accepting a subsequent VALID block/tx. Tests use only exported l1chain APIs plus in-package test access to gossip topics; no production p2p/node/chain code was modified and no validation was weakened. Every network block still flows through node.AcceptExternalBlock -> chain.AddBlock.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Malicious peer gossips a well-formed block (correct parent/height/tx root) whose Difficulty is bumped to an unreachable 250 leading-zero-bits so its hash cannot meet the target.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: AcceptExternalBlock rejects with chain.ErrBadPoW; honest Head stays at genesis (height 0) through 10 gossip re-deliveries; node stays alive and then accepts a subsequent VALID height-1 block over the network.
adversarial_cases.observed: direct submit -> ErrBadPoW; log 'drop invalid block h=1: chain: block hash does not meet difficulty' x10; head unchanged; valid block adopted (converged).

adversarial_cases.scenario: Tx validly signed by key X but From overwritten to a different address (mismatched From/signature) is gossiped on the l1/txs topic.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: SubmitTx rejects with node.ErrBadSignature; forged tx never enters the mempool via gossip; a subsequently gossiped VALID faucet tx IS admitted, and the mined block contains exactly that one valid tx (forged tx absent).
adversarial_cases.observed: direct SubmitTx -> ErrBadSignature; mempool 0 after 10 forged gossips; valid tx admitted (mempool 1); mined block Txs==[validTx].

adversarial_cases.scenario: Valid block with its Header.StateRoot tampered and re-mined so PoW passes but the re-derived state root cannot match; gossiped to honest node.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: AcceptExternalBlock rejects with chain.ErrBadStateRoot; Head stays at genesis through 10 gossip re-deliveries; node accepts a subsequent VALID block.
adversarial_cases.observed: direct submit -> ErrBadStateRoot; log 'drop invalid block h=1: chain: state root mismatch' x10; head unchanged; valid block adopted.

adversarial_cases.scenario: A peer answers the /l1/sync/1.0.0 stream with (a) raw non-gob garbage bytes, (b) a valid-gob but invalid (bad-PoW) block, (c) an out-of-order/unknown-parent height-2 block.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: The requesting honest node applies synced blocks via AcceptExternalBlock; garbage decodes to a graceful stream end with no adoption; invalid/out-of-order blocks make syncFrom return an error and abort; in ALL sub-cases Head stays at genesis and the node never crashes on malformed stream data.
adversarial_cases.observed: (a) Resync returns cleanly, head unchanged; (b) Resync returns non-nil error (ErrBadPoW), head unchanged; (c) Resync returns non-nil error (ErrUnknownParent), head unchanged; no panic.

adversarial_cases.scenario: The same VALID block is delivered many times: 1 initial accept + 50 direct replays + 50 gossip re-deliveries of the identical encoded block.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: First accept advances Head to height 1; every duplicate AcceptExternalBlock returns nil (idempotent, ErrDuplicateBlock mapped to nil); Head stays at height 1 with the correct hash; the coinbase reward is credited EXACTLY once (balance == chain.BlockReward=50, not doubled); no panic.
adversarial_cases.observed: 50/50 duplicate accepts returned nil; head height 1 stable; coinbase balance == 50 after both direct and gossip floods (no double application).

adversarial_cases.scenario: An orphan block (height 2) whose parent (height 1) the honest node lacks is gossiped by a peer that cannot serve the missing parent (its own chain is at genesis).
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: AcceptExternalBlock returns chain.ErrUnknownParent; the node attempts sync from the relaying peer, cannot obtain the parent, and DROPS the orphan rather than applying it out of order; Head stays at genesis. Once the parent is subsequently delivered, the node converges to height 2 in the correct order.
adversarial_cases.observed: direct submit -> ErrUnknownParent; log 'drop block h=2 after sync: chain: unknown parent block'; head stayed 0 during orphan-only flood; converged to height 2 after ordered parent+child delivery.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Random / empty / garbage byte payloads published to both l1/blocks and l1/txs topics.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: store.DecodeBlock / decodeTx fail; the read loops log and drop each undecodable message and keep running; Head unchanged (genesis), mempool empty; a subsequent VALID block is still accepted (read loops survived).
adversarial_cases.observed: logs 'drop undecodable block/tx: gob: encoded unsigned integer out of range | unexpected EOF | EOF'; head unchanged; mempool 0; valid block adopted afterward.

summary.note: No adversarial case revealed a defect. A malicious or broken peer could not corrupt an honest node's chain, could not make it adopt an invalid/out-of-order/orphan/forged artifact, and could not crash it. Every network block was validated through node.AcceptExternalBlock -> chain.AddBlock (PoW, tx merkle root, re-derived state root, parent linkage). Duplicate delivery is idempotent with single reward application; junk and malformed sync streams are handled gracefully.
